meta.description: Research competitor Facebook and Instagram ads from the Meta Ads Library via the Hyper MCP — search by keyword, pull full ad creative and metadata, enrich with page contact info for lead generation, and surface structured ad-intelligence summaries in chat. Use when the user wants to scrape the Meta Ads Library, spy on competitor ads, monitor new ads in a category, build a lead list from advertisers, or surface creative trends across an industry.
